displayName: Midship_W1 (raised deck, walls both ends, W1x/W1x)
description: Raised middle walled on BOTH faces (W1x standard both ends): stairs at the FORWARD end (Astra's kit as-authored), DOOR-ONLY closure (no stairs) at the AFT end. Measurement shows the full stair+guard kit's footprint is ~3.4 u deep from its wall plane (TwinStairs alone runs 3.2 u); two such kits would need ~6.8 u against this 6.0 u bay with none of the >=0.8 u clear-deck margin the spec asks for, so only ONE end gets stairs. See docs/RAISED-SECTIONS.md sec 3-4 and the Data+art results section for the measurement.

sockets.notes: Door-only wall face (no stairs): W1x standard.

droppedGunSlots.reason: DeckSlot_1 (x=3.5) clashes with the forward stairwell (local x 2.76-6.0). DeckSlot_0 (x=1.5) is not inside either wall's stairwell/bulkhead footprint, but sits close enough to the aft door-only bulkhead (which spans the full beam, x 0-~0.1) and the crew's only fore-aft route (up the forward stairs, the full 6 u deck, then presumably down again at the next module) that it is dropped here as a conservative provisional call rather than measured against the assembler's real clearance box this pass -- recommend re-checking DeckSlot_0 once the assembler runs this module.

visuals.notes: Closed at both faces: forward with the stair-corner gaps, aft solid full-beam (no gaps). 0 boundary anomalies, 0 degenerate faces.
Mirrored, aft end (door-only, no stairs). Cosmetic over the closed bulkhead -- not a walkable connection between decks at this end; crew reach the raised deck only via the forward stairs.
Mirrored, aft end -- frame trim only, no stairs/guards there.

equipmentSlots.notes: Unchanged from hull.middle.w1xr.v1; must keep clear of both walls/the forward stairwell.

passages.notes: Unchanged from hull.middle.w1xr.v1. Note this module is a raised-deck dead end aft (door-only wall, no stairs down) -- crew flow assumption for the ship design.

hydrostatics.notes: NOT re-exported this pass (time budget); see hull.middle.w1xr.wa.v1.json's identical note.
